verdicts.reason: Both are equally unusable. Each one lost the background photo, the teal overlay and the frame, and turned into scattered pieces on a white strip: a large cropped bone outline at the left, a flat teal rectangle with no content, a tiny stray photo thumbnail, and a cramped cluster of icons. The 'Dogs never bite me — just humans.' quote and the Marilyn Monroe attribution are reduced to illegible white-on-white scraps. The only difference is a slight change in how the left bone is drawn, so neither is better.
